resources.resource: Build Lead and trained stage crew
Work gloves, eye protection, and closed-toe shoes

step.action: Confirm the current stage drawing, scaffold instructions, part count, load limit, and final-state photograph in 📦 Build_Book.
step.ifThen: IF any information is missing or the parts differ, THEN do not build the stage.

step.action: Mark the stage footprint and audience boundary from 📦 Camp_Map.
Count and inspect every stage, scaffold, fastener, guard, brace, and anchor component.
Assemble the stage and scaffold in the manufacturer's printed sequence.
Install every required brace, guard, access component, fastener, and anchor.
Have the Build Lead compare the completed stage with the drawing and load-limit marking.

passWhen.criterion: The stage matches the current drawing and manufacturer instructions.
Every required brace, guard, fastener, access component, and anchor is installed.
The load limit is visible and the audience boundary is clear.
The Build Lead completed the final inspection.
